name: Netopeer (v1)
what_it_is: First-generation NETCONF Protocol Toolset by CESNET, built on libnetconf. Provides a NETCONF server daemon, CLI client, module manager, and configurator for managing NETCONF-enabled devices; deprecated in favour of Netopeer2.
components: netopeer-server — main NETCONF server daemon (integrated architecture, SSH/TLS transport)
netopeer-cli — interactive CLI client for connecting to NETCONF-enabled devices
netopeer-manager — tool to add/remove/enable/disable transAPI modules on the server
netopeer-configurator — first-run configuration tool (NACM, module paths, binaries location)
transAPI/cfgsystem — module implementing ietf-system data model (RFC 7317)
transAPI/cfginterfaces — module for managing network interfaces
protocols: NETCONF v1.1 (RFC 6241) with Chunked Framing Mechanism
NETCONF Call Home (Reverse SSH draft, TLS variant)
measurement: No built-in metrics or telemetry export — server exposes configuration datastores only
Logging verbosity controllable via -v 0-3 (errors, warnings, verbose, debug)
configuration: netopeer-configurator (Python curses UI) for first-run setup of NACM and module enablement
netopeer-manager for adding/removing transAPI .so modules at runtime
TLS client certificates placed in server/certs/ directory
NACM default-write-action and per-user unlimited-access configurable via netopeer-configurator
SSH host keys generated with ssh-keygen -A at container build time
fault_injection: No dedicated fault-injection facility; operator can send malformed or rejected NETCONF RPCs via netopeer-cli to test server error handling
NACM can be configured to deny write operations, simulating an access-control fault condition
modes: Foreground/verbose mode: netopeer-server -v 2 (default in Docker CMD)
TLS transport mode (requires --enable-tls at compile time)
constraints: No longer maintained; authors recommend migrating to Netopeer2 (libyang-based)
Docker image based on CentOS 7 (EOL); not suitable for production use without significant update
TLS support is compile-time only (--enable-tls) and is not enabled in the provided Dockerfile
No docker-compose file provided; single-container deployment only, exposing port 830
Requires libnetconf, libssh >= 0.6.4, pyang >= 1.5.0, python 2.6+, and augeas-devel at build time
NACM blocks all writes by default; must be explicitly relaxed before configuration changes work
docker_services: netopeer — single service; CentOS 7 base; builds libnetconf + netopeer-server + cfgsystem; exposes port 830 (mapped to host 8300 in docs example); CMD runs netopeer-server -v 2
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml — only a bare Dockerfile
No YANG library or model discovery endpoint beyond what libnetconf provides
No automated test harness or CI integration visible in the repository root
Netopeer GUI is a separate project (CESNET/Netopeer-GUI) and not included here
